steps.title: Opener
steps.rule: Spread loosely around the centre before Ifrit lands.

steps.title: Run to the opener safe spot
steps.rule: Run to the rim on the side without a Radiant Plume, in two tight rows, so the dash misses everyone.

steps.title: Tank Ifrit south, party north
steps.rule: Party groups north of centre; the main tank takes Ifrit south.

MainTank.rule: Take Ifrit south of centre, facing away from the party.

steps.title: Surround the nails, Ifrit between the close pair
steps.rule: Party spreads loosely at the nail spot; the main tank pulls Ifrit between the close pair of nails.

MainTank.rule: Pull Ifrit between the two close nails, away from the party.

steps.title: Eruption baiters split to the rim
steps.rule: Physical ranged and caster split to opposite points on the rim to bait the first Eruptions.

steps.title: Searing Wind holder leaves
steps.rule: With Searing Wind, run to the rim opposite the close nails and stay away from everyone.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 1
steps.rule: Baiters step along the rim to the next bait spot.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 2
steps.rule: Baiters keep walking the rim, one spot ahead of the last Eruption.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 3
steps.rule: Baiters keep walking the rim, one spot ahead of the last Eruption.

steps.title: Baiters return
steps.rule: Baiters come back to the party at the nails.

steps.title: Searing Wind holder returns
steps.rule: Once Searing Wind is gone, rejoin the party at the nails.

steps.title: Back to the centre
steps.rule: Everyone loosely around the centre for Hellfire.

steps.title: Gather in the last nail's corner
steps.rule: Party gathers in the corner of the last nail; the main tank stands a bit further out.

MainTank.rule: Stand on the corner line, further out than the party.

steps.title: Baiters to the rim
steps.rule: Physical ranged and caster move to the rim north-east to bait the next Eruptions.

steps.title: Second Searing Wind holder leaves
steps.rule: With Searing Wind, run to the south-west rim and stay there.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 1
steps.rule: Baiters step along the rim to the next bait spot.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 2
steps.rule: Baiters keep walking the rim.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 3
steps.rule: Baiters keep walking the rim.

steps.title: Baiters back to the corner
steps.rule: Baiters rejoin the party in the corner.

steps.title: Third Searing Wind holder leaves
steps.rule: With Searing Wind, run to the north-east rim.

steps.title: Second holder rejoins
steps.rule: Rejoin the party in the corner once Searing Wind is gone.

steps.title: Third holder moves south-east
steps.rule: Keep Searing Wind away: move to the south-east rim.

steps.title: Dodge the Crimson Cyclone dashes
steps.rule: Stand where no clone's dash line and no awakened cross will hit; follow the marker as it moves.
steps.cue: Ifrit clones appear at the nail spots

steps.title: Tank Ifrit west, party east of him
steps.rule: Party groups just east of Ifrit; the main tank takes him west.

MainTank.rule: Take Ifrit to the west edge, facing away from the party.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 1
steps.rule: Baiters bait along the rim, starting south-east.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 2
steps.rule: Baiters keep walking the rim.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 3
steps.rule: Baiters keep walking the rim.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 4
steps.rule: Baiters keep walking the rim.

steps.title: Baiters return
steps.rule: Baiters rejoin the party east of Ifrit.
